posts.title: Lens-Artists Challenge #423 – Atmospheric
posts.description: Storm at Sea “Life isn’t about waiting for the storm to pass…It’s about learning to dance in the rain.” Vivian Greene This week Ann-Christine leads us on a search for atmospheric images. Ever-creative, her post explores many ways to approach the subject. I’ve chosen to focus primarily on atmospheric weather conditions, such as are illustrated both above and below. However I’ve sprinkled in a few non-weather images in honor of Ann-Christine’s beautiful examples. Weathered Crossing “Listening is the bridge between pain and understanding.” Shamail Aijaz Dismissing the focus on weather for the moment, the next image struck me as atmospheric based on the rather spooky feeling it engendered – at least to me . Its slightly out-of-focus presentation may or may not have been on purpose – I’ll claim the former but who knows?! Whatever the answer, I filed it away and think it fits today’s bill. posts.title: Lens-Artists Challenge #422 – Food and Drink
posts.description: Breads A-Plenty “When strangers share bread, borders blur.” Lawrence Nault This week Beth offers us an opportunity to share images of what must count among everyone’s favorite things – food and/or drink. I don’t know about you but sharing a delicious meal with good friends and/or family is high on my list of must-haves. Both bread and fruit, featured in this week’s opening image, are among my favorites. While not a “must-have” but definitely a “want-to-have”, one of my absolute favorites….CHOCOLATE! Can’t Live Without….CHOCOLATE! “There is nothing better than a friend, unless it is a friend with chocolate.” Linda Grayson It’s a bit hard for me to believe, but not everyone loves chocolate. For those among you who fall into that category, I offer the following beautifully packaged sugary option . posts.title: Lens-Artists Challenge #421 – Exploring Geometry
posts.description: Geometric Wonder “Sacred Geometry is the Language of Light.” Sino Melo This week Patti leads us on an exploration of the wonders of geometry. It is, of course, everywhere. Choosing images for the week’s post was primarily an exercise in reducing the number of images that fit the brief. My opening image was chosen because of the variety of geometric shapes it contains. The same is true for the image that follows. Shapes in Iron “The geometry of the things around us creates coincidences, intersections.” Erri De Luca In a more colorful approach I loved the patterns and shapes in the image that follows. To be honest, I’m fairly certain it was a floor tile but wouldn’t put money on it!! I loved that it includes triangles, squares and in the center a tiny circle.
